mihomo.custom_config:
# 全局配置 
port: 7890
socks-port: 7891
redir-port: 7892
mixed-port: 7893
tproxy-port: 7894
allow-lan: true
bind-address: "*"
ipv6: false
unified-delay: true
tcp-concurrent: true
log-level: warning
find-process-mode: 'strict'   #进程匹配 always/strict/off
# interface-name: en0
keep-alive-idle: 600
keep-alive-interval: 15
disable-keep-alive: false
profile:
  store-selected: true
  store-fake-ip: true

# 控制面板
external-controller: 0.0.0.0:9090
secret: "123456"
external-ui: "ui"
#external-ui-name: metacubexd
#external-ui-url: "https://github.com/MetaCubeX/metacubexd/archive/refs/heads/gh-pages.zip"
external-ui-url: "https://github.com/Zephyruso/zashboard/archive/refs/heads/gh-pages.zip"

# 嗅探
sniffer:
  enable: true
  sniff:
    HTTP:
      ports: [80, 8080-8880]
      override-destination: true
    TLS:
      ports: [443, 8443]
    QUIC:
      ports: [443, 8443]
  force-domain:
    - "+.v2ex.com"
  skip-domain:
 #   - "rule-set:Private,Direct"
    - "dlg.io.mi.com"
    - "+.push.apple.com"
    - "+.apple.com"
    - "+.wechat.com"
    - "+.qpic.cn"
    - "+.qq.com"
    - "+.wechatapp.com"
    - "+.vivox.com"
    - "+.oray.com"
    - "+.sunlogin.net"
    - "+.msftconnecttest.com"
    - "+.msftncsi.com"

# 入站  
tun:
  enable: true
  # system/gvisor/mixed
  stack: mixed
  dns-hijack: ["any:53", "tcp://any:53"]
  auto-route: true
  auto-redirect: true
  auto-detect-interface: true
  #中国IP绕过内核
 # route-exclude-address-set:
#     - "rule-set:ChinaMaxNoIP,Custom_Direct"

# DNS模块
dns:
  enable: true
  listen: 0.0.0.0:1053
  ipv6: false
  respect-rules: true
  enhanced-mode: fake-ip
  fake-ip-range: 198.18.0.1/16
  fake-ip-filter-mode: blacklist
  fake-ip-filter:
#    - "rule-set:Private,Direct"
    - '*.lan'
    - '*.local'
    - '*.arpa'
    - 'time.*.com'
    - 'ntp.*.com'
    - '+.pool.ntp.org'
    - "+.ntp.ntsc.ac.cn"
    - "+.cn.ntp.org.cn"
    - '+.market.xiaomi.com'
    - 'localhost.ptlogin2.qq.com'
    - '*.msftncsi.com'
    - 'www.msftconnecttest.com'
  default-nameserver:
    - https://223.5.5.5/dns-query
    - https://1.12.12.12/dns-query

  # 直连 DNS 服务器，用于解析不需要代理的域名（通常为国内域名）
  # 使用 DoH（DNS over HTTPS）以保护隐私，防止 DNS 污染
  direct-nameserver:
    - https://223.5.5.5/dns-query
    - https://1.12.12.12/dns-query

  # 控制直连 DNS 是否遵循 nameserver-policy 的策略
  # 设置为 false，确保直连域名始终使用 direct-nameserver 中的服务器
  direct-nameserver-follow-policy: false

  # 代理节点域名解析，只用于解析机场节点服务器自己的域名，不解析其他网站
  # 使用国内 DoH，确保节点域名能解析、能连上
  proxy-server-nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query

  # DNS 解析策略，针对特定域名或规则集指定专用的 DNS 服务器
  # 优化规则以覆盖常见国内服务，降低延迟
  nameserver-policy:
    '+.115.com': '223.5.5.5'          # 115.com 及其子域名使用阿里 DNS
    # 'rule-set:gfw_domain': '8.8.8.8'     # GFW 屏蔽域名使用 Google DNS，绕过限制

  # 全局 DNS 服务器，作为默认解析的最终备用
  # 优先使用 DoH 服务器以增强隐私保护
  nameserver:
    - https://doh.pub/dns-query
    - https://dns.alidns.com/dns-query
